@: The update card (bottom right), the status bar link and the Settings > Updates line (web/js/updates.js).
card.title: WardogClips {version} is available
card.starting: Starting the installer. WardogClips will close now.
card.failed: The update did not work. Try again later.
card.no_installer: This release has no installer for Windows. Get it from the download page.
card.from_source: You are running WardogClips from source. Get the new version from the download page.
bar.link_title: A newer WardogClips is available. Click to see what is new.
set.disabled: No update source is set, so WardogClips does not check for updates.
set.available_skipped: Version {version} is available. You chose to skip it.
@reason.not_found: Reasons the server gives by code (the server also sends the English text).
reason.not_found: The update page could not be found. The releases may be private, or none are published yet.
reason.rate_limited: GitHub is limiting update checks right now. WardogClips will try again later.
reason.offline: Could not reach GitHub. Check your internet connection.
reason.bad_response: GitHub sent an answer WardogClips could not read. It will try again later.
reason.http_error: GitHub answered with an error. WardogClips will try again later.
reason.bad_repo: The update source in Settings > Updates is not a valid owner/name.
reason.disabled: No update source is set, so WardogClips does not check for updates.
reason.no_asset: This release has no Windows installer to download. Use the download page instead.
reason.not_installed: Automatic updating works in the installed version only. Use the download page instead.
reason.bad_checksum: The downloaded file did not match its checksum, so it was deleted. Try again later.
reason.checksum_unreadable: The checksum file of this release could not be read, so nothing was installed.
reason.too_big: The installer of this release is larger than expected, so it was not downloaded.
reason.download_failed: The download did not finish. Try again to resume it.
reason.launch_failed: The installer could not be started. Open the download page and run it yourself.
reason.nothing: There is no update to install.
reason.need_confirm: This release has no checksum, so WardogClips cannot verify the download. Install it only if you trust where it came from.
